title: Principal Technical Account Manager
description:
**Job Summary**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
 As a Principal Technical Account Manager, you will serve as a trusted customer advocate and senior technical advisor. You will translate customer business requirements into integrated solutions, assess cloud environments, identify gaps, and guide customers through cloud adoption and implementation.
   

  

 You will provide technical leadership across the full solution lifecycle—from discovery and design through build, testing, deployment, and go\-live—while coordinating cross\-functional teams to remove blockers and drive successful customer outcomes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with customers to understand business goals, requirements, challenges, and desired outcomes, translating them into practical technical and process solutions.
* Lead fit\-gap assessments of customer cloud environments and develop roadmaps for cloud transition, implementation, and optimization.
* Define and align the functional and technical vision for program solutions with customer and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and oversee end\-to\-end delivery across requirements intake, design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live.
* Design secure, scalable OCI architectures, including networking, security, identity and access management, and infrastructure frameworks.
* Guide deployment of customer workloads to OCI, support cloud\-adoption models, and recommend actions to remove delivery blockers.
* Align customer solutions with Oracle product roadmaps, release cycles, business enhancements, and production break\-fix requirements.
* Collaborate with portfolio management and cross\-functional teams, including business analysts, integration specialists, quality assurance, development, support, services, and third\-party partners.
* Communicate solution options, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical customer stakeholders.
* Contribute to strategic planning, program governance, customer satisfaction, service delivery, and cross\-functional team leadership.


**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications \& Skills**
**Mandatory**
* 11 years of experience in a customer\-facing, consultative, or technology\-related role; or an equivalent combination of education and experience:
+ Bachelor’s degree in business, computer information systems, computer science, or a related field plus 7 years of relevant experience.
+ Master’s degree in a related field plus 5 years of relevant experience.
+ Doctorate in a related field plus 3 years of relevant experience.

* 8–15 years of IT industry experience, including at least 5 years of demonstrated OCI experience.
* Hands\-on expertise with OCI, including cloud architecture, workload deployment, networking, security, and IAM.
* Strong Terraform experience for provisioning and managing OCI resources.
* Proficiency in Bash, Python, Shell, or similar scripting and programming languages.
* Experience deploying and managing containerised workloads on Kubernetes, ideally Oracle Kubernetes Engine.
* Experience building observability dashboards and alerts with Prometheus and Grafana.
* Demonstrated experience leading business analysis, business\-process design, and software delivery lifecycle activities.
* Proven ability to lead cross\-functional programs, coordinate stakeholders, manage resources, and deliver solutions on time and within budget.
* Strong client relationship, service delivery, incident response, account management, contract management, and compliance capabilities.
* Excellent analytical, written, verbal, presentation, and organizational skills.
* Ability to travel to customer and internal locations up to 25%.


**Good\-to\-Have**
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
* OCI or other relevant cloud certifications.
* Experience with modern CI/CD and DevOps tools and practices.
* At least one full cloud implementation lifecycle.
* Experience supporting operating budgets or project financials.
* Deep familiarity with the CSS service portfolio across cloud and on\-premises offerings.
* Additional experience in IT service management and account management.


**Self\-Assessment Questions**
* Do I have hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting secure workloads on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure?
* Can I use Terraform and scripting tools such as Python, Bash, or Shell to provision and manage cloud infrastructure?
* Have I led a customer solution through discovery, design, build, testing, deployment, and go\-live while coordinating multiple stakeholders?
* Am I comfortable translating customer business needs into technical architectures, cloud\-adoption roadmaps, and actionable recommendations?
* Have I worked with Kubernetes, cloud networking, IAM, security controls, and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana?


**About Us**
 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life\-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
   

  

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
   

  

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation\-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1\-888\-404\-2494 in the United States.
   

  

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

title: Team Lead - Claims(Hyderabad)

description:
**Job Purpose**
 Plan, monitor and provide technical services and training to Key Customers across the Zone to ensure customized concrete solutions, value added services and brand leadership.
   

  

**Job Context \& Major Challenges**
 UltraTech Cement is the largest cement manufacturer in India with an installed capacity of about 68 million tonnes. The company has production facilities in 17 locations spread across the country and has plans to grow further than acquisition and green field expansion. The UltraTech brand occupies a premium position with a market capitalization of Rs. 81438 crores. The Indian cement industry has a capacity of 409 million tonnes and a supply demand gap putting pressure of prices due to excess capacity. The market has strong regional players in each Zone and has strong brand competition.
   

  

 Key Accounts Business was a pioneer initiative that aimed to provide focused attention to the top 100 institutional customers (mainly construction companies in India). The aim was to provide them with a dedicated sales force responsible for identifying customer needs and understanding emerging trends so as to ensure effective brand positioning and building market share. In this segment, it is vital to nurture strong relationships with clients and consultants to understand their specific needs and act as a trusted advisor to the business.
   

  

 Although it is an established business with 3000 crore revenue and 18% of total cement sales, the major challenges being to serve Key Customers across India, complex supply chain and strong customer interface. The increasing complexity of construction practices, demanding application for infrastructure projects like metros, highways, ports \& airports and meeting specifications of international standards pose a constant challenge to provide the required quantity and quality of cement.l of complex quality complaint.
   

  

* Technical problems in concrete related to workability due to compatibility of chemical admixtures.
* Maintenance of Brand Superiority and Price Premium in face of stiff competition – Maintaining of Exclusive Supplier / First Preferred Supplier Status \& max Share of Business (SOB) in the Signature Projects.


**Key Result Areas**
**KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)** 
**Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)**
 KRA1 Product Promotion and Brand Equity 1
   

  

* (A) Visit Key Customers, their consultants, engineers \& architects and organize product demonstration / concrete mix design trials at client site
* (R) Increase brand equity of UltraTech brand through increased share of business, being the preferred cement supplier to Key Customers, setting up dedicated RMC plants at key customer sites
* (R,A) Brand approval / conversion for enhancing share of business
* (R,A) Conduct technical meets in the Zone for influencers (e.g. Architects, Engineers, Consultants etc.) and explore opportunities for promoting technologies for mass housing, white topping, road concreting etc.
* (R,A) Contribute in improving company's reputation amongst technical clients by writing articles and preparing technical presentations on cement / concrete technology


 KRA10 UltraTechAccess Web site
   

  

* Downloading test certificates from SAP and updating the website regularly. Training the site teams to effectively use the website for the information loaded.


 KRA2 Product Promotion and Brand Equity 2
   

  

* (R,A) Educate customer through direct mailing \& field demonstrations
* (R,A) Interact and meet regularly with customers / consultants / contractors, participate in the technical \& sales presentations and liaise with associations \& professional bodies
* (R,A) Promote the company’s cement products including RMC in different sectors, in the zone by organizing product awareness meets for the key influencers like Project manager, Consultants, Architects, Clients and Project promoters ( Private and Government)
* (R,A) Write about Company's products and newer developments, attend relevant seminars / conferences etc. and share the learning’s with Key Customers


 KRA3 Partnering with Customers / Value Added Services
   

  

* (A) Conduct concrete mix design trials at client site and provide help in optimizing concrete mix designs
* (A) Provide assistance to existing customers with respect to technical assistance like mix design optimization, latest civil practices, tenders etc.
* (R,A) Render effective solutions to customer sites / provide construction related solutions and improve the quality aspects of the sites through visit of Industry Experts
* (R,A) Support customers in details of construction related materials (shuttering etc.) and equipment (silos etc.) suppliers and manufacturers for timely completion of project


 KRA4 Market Strategy
   

  

* (R) Devise the market strategy based on customer feedback, consultants and new projects to recommend new markets, capacity enhancements and quantity requirements for the Zone


 KRA5 Market Intelligence
   

  

* (R) Monitor competitive activities including sales, pricing, product innovations and new construction practices, close interaction with key stakeholders like consultants, industry experts and professional bodies
* (R,A) Collect the samples of other brands and get it tested in labs and provide information on competitor’s products and services to help develop counter action plans


 (R,A) Visit Key Customers' project sites, collect information on quality parameters and mix design and getting their feedback on competitors activities
   

  

 KRA6 Assistance to Internal Stakeholders
   

  

* (A) Assess the extent of damaged cement on defined norms / Test the material for extent of damage as per norms and calculate / recommend the amount of discount that can be given on sale
* (A) Assist the marketing team to achieve their performance targets by making customer calls to Key Accounts and promote products / Visit along with the Marketing team members to meet Key Customer / new customer


 KRA7 Customer Complaints \& Quality
   

  

* (A) Organize testing of the cement / concrete at plant and independent test laboratory
* (A) Resolve customer complaints / quality issues and enquiries by meeting the complainants and potential customers
* (A) Visit customers sites, physically examine the material / site and test the quality of bags


 KRA8 Value Added Services
   

  

* Customized pre \& post technical services.
* Promotion of Building Products.


 KRA9 Brand Building
   

  

* Facilitating \& organizing for lecture of Technical Consultant to key customer.
* Facilitate / Organize study tour visit to Signature projects.

title: Service Delivery Manager, gTech Ads Customer Experience
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross\-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client\-facing role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet\-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi\-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large\-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.


**About the job** 
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI\-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool\-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre\-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real\-world performance metrics.
   

  

 Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the end\-to\-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi\-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre\-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 Quince Capital is a lending company focused on helping MSMEs access credit that moves in step with their day\-to\-day business needs. The organization provides working capital and property\-backed loans with fast access, flexible repayment cycles, and instant top\-ups for eligible customers. Its approach aligns credit to clients’ cash flow, seasonality, and growth, rather than forcing businesses to adapt to rigid financing structures. Quince Capital uses real\-time systems to understand business rhythm and offers a seamless experience that blends digital efficiency with human support. The company invites partners and professionals who are committed to building, backing, or enabling MSME growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Relationship Manager role based in Hyderabad. The Relationship Manager will build and manage relationships with MSME customers, understand their financing needs, and recommend suitable lending products and solutions. Responsibilities include onboarding new clients, explaining product features and terms, assisting with documentation, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth loan processing. The role involves proactive portfolio management, monitoring customer accounts and repayment behavior, and identifying opportunities for cross\-selling or upselling credit solutions. The Relationship Manager will also handle customer queries and issues, maintain accurate records in CRM or loan management systems, and contribute to business development initiatives and local market outreach.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Customer relationship skills: ability to build trust, maintain long\-term client relationships, and provide consultative support to MSME customers.
* Sales and business development skills: experience in sourcing leads, converting prospects, and achieving lending or financial services targets.
* Credit and financial understanding: basic knowledge of lending products, risk assessment, cash flow analysis, and MSME financing needs.
* Communication and negotiation skills: strong verbal and written communication, active listening, and the ability to negotiate terms within policy guidelines.
* Operational and coordination skills: attention to detail in documentation, comfort with digital tools and CRM systems, and ability to work effectively with internal teams.
* General qualifications: bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; prior experience in banking, NBFCs, fintech, or MSME lending is preferred.
* Personal attributes: integrity, customer\-centric mindset, resilience in a fast\-paced environment, and readiness to work on\-site in Hyderabad.

title: Payroll Vendor Manager, Amazon Global Payroll team
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Payroll team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, whilst keeping our costs controlled and complying with all regulatory requirements. The Amazon Payroll team is looking for an energetic, enthusiastic relationship manager with outstanding analytical, negotiation, and project management skills to join our Vendor Management team.
   

  

 The Payroll Vendor Manager is responsible for payroll vendor selection, and vendor management across all countries. This position will help oversee the performance of payroll service providers (vendors) and keep all agreements current. description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing global accounts to enterprise\-level customers.
   

  

 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Sr. Engagement Manager to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you will lead delivery quality and velocity for programs spanning several concurrent workstreams, orchestrating 50\+ person teams of AWS builders, partners, and customers to deliver transformational AI, data, and enterprise modernization outcomes for the world's leading HCLS organizations.
   

  

 Your objective will be to deliver distinctive customer business outcomes and experience. In doing so, you will lead the implementation of AWS delivery innovations with customers, including re\-designing software development processes to become AI\-native end\-to\-end (“AI\-DLC”). You will bring exceptional stakeholder orchestration and relationship\-building skills, intrinsic problem\-solving ability to proactively shape program direction, anticipate and mitigate risks, and actively manage interdependencies, and the backbone to influence customers and partners when program success demands it. This is an opportunity to shape the future of the industry directly through hands\-on transformation leadership.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Build and nurture trusted executive relationships (VP\+), delivering strategic counsel on program direction, health, risks, and trade\-offs to inform executive decisions
* Proactively manage interdependencies, mitigate risks, and drive accountability for program outcomes in ambiguous, fast\-changing environments
* Orchestrate across customer lines of business, IT, and partner teams simultaneously, aligning these stakeholders on priorities, timelines, and definitions of success, and escalating blockers where necessary for resolution
* Define and track measurable customer business outcomes (e.g., time\-to\-market acceleration) as the north star for program success, translating technical delivery progress into executive\-ready value narratives that demonstrate ROI and inform strategic decisions
* Own the program financial health, including forecasting, revenue recognition, commercial management, change request negotiation, and scope management for fixed\-price, milestone\-based delivery constructs
* Influence human builder and agent builder teams effectively, establishing clear operating models and responsible AI guardrails as delivery increasingly incorporates AI\-augmented development workflows and agentic automation
* Drive adoption of AI\-DLC (AI\-Driven Development Life Cycle) methodologies across delivery programs, adapting delivery models and team structures for accelerated scale and pace, establishing outcomes\-based governance frameworks for AI\-native builds, and steering multi\-agent systems at scale to drive delivery productivity across the program
* Establish and enforce governance frameworks for agentic AI in delivery — including observability, cost controls, human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, and compliance guardrails — ensuring AI\-augmented workflows remain auditable, secure, and aligned with customer regulatory requirements
* Proactively surface ideas on how ProServe and other AWS teams can innovate to help our customers achieve their goals at a faster pace and larger scale

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

title: City Head - Medtech Company, Hyderabad
description:
**Job Description**
 The City Head — Hyderabad is a business\-founder role. You will own the full P\&L for Hyderabad, architect the go\-to\-market strategy, build and lead a high\-performance team, and be the face of the organisation's category\-building mission in the city. This is not a sales management role — it is a general management role with the remit to shape how cardiac rhythm intelligence gets adopted across hospitals, cardiologists, electrophysiologists, and diagnostic networks in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Revenue Growth \& Business Development


 ▸ Own revenue targets for Hyderabad across all product lines — ambulatory monitoring, CRI platform subscriptions, and clinical services.
   

  

 ▸ Drive new account acquisition across hospitals, cardiology departments, EP labs, and diagnostic chains; develop a pipeline management discipline with clear conversion metrics.
   

  

 ▸ Design and execute city\-level GTM playbooks — account mapping, HCP engagement, institutional tie\-ups, and channel partnerships.
   

  

 ▸ Identify and unlock high\-value revenue levers: hospital protocols, corporate wellness, insurance partnerships, and tele\-cardiology integrations.
   

  

 ▸ Track, forecast, and report revenue performance weekly; model scenario\-based growth plans in alignment with national targets.
   

  

* P\&L Ownership \& Financial Management


 ▸ Own the Hyderabad P\&L end\-to\-end — revenue, cost of delivery, operational expenses, and contribution margin.
   

  

 ▸ Build annual operating plans and quarterly budgets; manage actuals vs. plan with rigour and transparency.
   

  

 ▸ Drive profitability through unit economics discipline: monitor cost per case, revenue per account, and payback periods on acquisition spend.
   

  

 ▸ Identify and eliminate cost inefficiencies without compromising clinical quality or service experience.
   

  

 ▸ Report financial performance to CBO/leadership with insight\-driven commentary, not just numbers.
   

  

* Category Building — Cardiac Rhythm Intelligence


 ▸ Serve as the primary category evangelist for cardiac rhythm intelligence (CRI) in Hyderabad — among cardiologists, hospital administrations, and patient communities.
   

  

 ▸ Drive physician education and awareness programs around arrhythmia under\-diagnosis, the role of AI\-assisted monitoring, and clinical outcomes enabled by CRI.
   

  

 ▸ Build the organisation's brand equity in Hyderabad through CMEs, EP meets, clinical roundtables, and key opinion leader (KOL) engagement.
   

  

 ▸ Establish Hyderabad as a reference city for CRI adoption — creating case studies, clinical outcomes data, and institutional endorsements that support national and investor narratives.
   

  

 ▸ Work closely with the clinical and product teams to translate market feedback into platform evolution.
   

  

* Team Building \& People Leadership


 ▸ Recruit, develop, and retain a high\-performance Hyderabad team across sales, clinical coordination, operations, and customer success functions.
   

  

 ▸ Set clear KPIs and performance expectations; conduct regular reviews and coaching conversations.
   

  

 ▸ Create a culture of accountability, clinical empathy, and growth orientation — consistent with Organisation's mission\-driven DNA.
   

  

 ▸ Build bench strength: identify and develop successors and specialist leads within the city team.
   

  

 ▸ Act as the connective tissue between the city team and national functions (product, clinical, finance, marketing).
   

  

* Operations \& Service Excellence


 ▸ Ensure flawless service delivery across all active accounts — device logistics, turnaround times, report quality, and clinical support.
   

  

 ▸ Establish city\-level SOPs for onboarding, monitoring workflows, escalations, and renewals.
   

  

 ▸ Own NPS and retention metrics; build structured feedback loops with clinical partners to continuously improve service experience.
   

  

 ▸ Ensure regulatory and compliance adherence for all city operations.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like (Year 1\)
   

  

 Revenue \- Achieve or exceed Hyderabad annual revenue target; consistent MoM growth trajectory
   

  

 Accounts \- Establish active relationships with leading cardiac hospitals and EP labs in Hyderabad
   

  

 P\&L \- Deliver positive contribution margin by Q3; meet opex efficiency targets
   

  

 Category \- Conduct physician education events; establish 2–3 reference KOLs
   

  

 Team \- Full city team in place by Q2; attrition below benchmark
   

  

 NPS \- Net Promoter Score from clinical partners consistently above 60
   

  

 Ideal Candidate Profile
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

 ▸ 12–18 years of total experience; at least 5 years in a city/regional P\&L leadership role in healthcare, healthtech, medtech, diagnostics, or pharma.
   

  

 ▸ Proven track record of building revenue from early\-stage or expansion\-stage business units — not just managing mature accounts.
   

  

 ▸ Prior exposure to cardiac, rhythm management, diagnostics, or clinical SaaS strongly preferred.
   

  

 ▸ Experience hiring and leading cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.
   

  

 Leadership \& General Management
   

  

 ▸ Genuine owner mindset — treats the P\&L as their own business, not a cost centre.
   

  

 ▸ Comfortable with ambiguity; can build structure and process from scratch while executing simultaneously.
   

  

 ▸ Strong commercial instincts balanced with clinical sensitivity and respect for the healthcare context.
   

  

 ▸ Track record of coaching teams to performance, not just directing them.
   

  

 Category \& Market Building
   

  

 ▸ Experience or strong intuition for category creation — educating a market that may not yet know it has a problem is different from selling into an established need.
   

  

 ▸ Ability to engage credibly with cardiologists, electrophysiologists, hospital managements, and clinical decision\-makers.
   

  

 ▸ Comfortable being the face of the organisation externally — at conferences, CMEs, and institutional conversations.
   

  

 Analytical \& Operational
   

  

 ▸ Strong financial acumen — can read, build, and defend a P\&L; comfortable with unit economics modelling.
   

  

 ▸ Data\-driven decision\-maker; uses metrics to manage performance, not just report it.
   

  

 ▸ Operationally sharp — understands delivery logistics, turnaround time management, and service SLAs.
   

  

**Location**
 Hyderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India 500001
   

  

**Qualification**
 MBA
   

  

**Department**
 General

 Hyderabad
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports To:** 
 Business Head / Founder
 


 About Bazaar.in
 
 Bazaar.in helps brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers liquidate surplus and slow\-moving inventory while offering consumers quality products at attractive prices.
 


 Role Overview
 
 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace operations.
 



 The role will be responsible for
 **strategizing and executing initiatives that grow sellers, business buyers, consumers, GMV and revenue** 
 . The candidate will manage the complete growth funnel from identifying acquisition opportunities and onboarding sellers to driving customer acquisition, conversion, repeat purchases and marketplace performance.
 



 This is a cross\-functional role requiring the ability to move between
 **strategy and execution** 
 , identify growth opportunities from data, run experiments, coordinate teams and take accountability for measurable business outcomes.
 


 Seller Growth \& Acquisition
 * Build and execute strategies to acquire brands, manufacturers, distributors and retailers.
* Generate seller leads through outbound sales, digital campaigns, referrals, events and partnerships.
* Manage strategic negotiations and seller onboarding.
* Ensure KYC completion, catalogue activation, competitive pricing and inventory availability.
* Improve seller activation, retention and contribution to marketplace revenue.


 B2B Growth \& Business Development
 * Acquire retailers, resellers, corporate buyers, institutional buyers and bulk purchasers.
* Build and manage a qualified B2B sales pipeline.
* Match buyer requirements with relevant marketplace inventory.
* Develop partnerships and outbound campaigns for high\-value and category\-specific inventory.
* Negotiate commercial terms and manage strategic accounts.
* Increase bulk orders, repeat purchases and revenue from active business buyers.


 B2C Marketing \& Customer Growth
 * Develop and execute performance marketing, social media, SEO, content, influencer and partnership strategies.
* Plan campaigns around deals, categories, inventory and customer segments.
* Manage marketing budgets and improve CAC, ROAS and conversion rates.
* Increase qualified website traffic, new customers, first purchases, average order value and repeat purchases.
* Develop CRM, remarketing, loyalty and referral programmes.
* Identify and improve drop\-offs across product discovery, product pages, cart and checkout.


 Marketplace \& Revenue Growth
 * Take ownership of marketplace growth across supply, demand and conversion.
* Align seller inventory with customer demand.
* Drive
 **GMV, revenue, order volume, sell\-through and contribution margin** 
 .
* Improve merchandising, pricing, promotions and product visibility.
* Identify high\-growth categories, sellers, products and customer segments.
* Analyse sales, marketing, seller and customer data to identify growth opportunities.
* Design and execute growth experiments and measure their impact.
* Work with catalogue, operations, technology and finance teams to remove growth bottlenecks.



 The GMV, revenue, sell\-through and contribution\-margin responsibilities already form part of the existing role, so this broader growth framing is consistent with the original scope rather than creating an entirely different position.
 


 Growth Strategy \& Execution
 * Develop short\-term and long\-term growth plans for Bazaar.in.
* Translate company growth objectives into executable sales and marketing initiatives.
* Identify new acquisition channels, partnerships and revenue opportunities.
* Prioritise initiatives based on business impact, cost and scalability.
* Run growth experiments across seller acquisition, customer acquisition, conversion and retention.
* Track results and continuously optimise initiatives based on data.
* Maintain a clear growth pipeline covering initiatives, owners, timelines and expected outcomes.


 Team Leadership
 * Lead and manage sales and marketing team members.
* Set measurable targets across seller acquisition, B2B sales, customer growth, GMV and revenue.
* Establish CRM, reporting, forecasting and performance\-review processes.
* Coordinate closely with catalogue, operations, finance and technology teams.
* Create accountability for execution and achievement of growth targets.


 Key Performance Indicators
 * Qualified and activated sellers
* Seller activation and retention
* B2B pipeline value and conversion
* Active B2B buyers and repeat business
* New B2C customers acquired
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* ROAS
* Website traffic and conversion rate
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Repeat\-purchase rate
* Inventory sell\-through
* Order volume
* GMV
* Revenue
* Contribution margin
* Growth experiment performance
* Team target achievement



 These metrics are largely already present in the existing JD, including CAC, ROAS, traffic, conversion, AOV, repeat purchases, sell\-through, GMV and revenue.
 


 Candidate Profile
 * 3\-7 years of experience in e\-commerce, marketplaces, D2C, retail, sales, marketing or growth roles.
* At least 2\-3 years of experience managing sales, marketing or growth teams.
* Proven experience in driving customer acquisition, seller/vendor acquisition, business development or marketplace growth.
* Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles, digital marketing, CRM, conversion optimisation and marketplace economics.
* Ability to combine
 **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** 
 .
* Strong commercial, negotiation, analytical and leadership skills.
* Comfortable working with growth metrics including CAC, ROAS, conversion, AOV, GMV and revenue.
* Proficiency in CRM systems, analytics tools, advertising platforms and Excel.
* Data\-driven, target\-oriented and comfortable working in a fast\-paced startup environment.


 What We Offer
 
**Ownership of the growth of Bazaar.in across sales, marketing and marketplace performance.** 




 The role provides direct exposure to company leadership and strategy, significant responsibility for business growth, fixed compensation with performance\-linked incentives, and career progression based on measurable business outcomes.
 



 The biggest change I would make compared with the current document is therefore
 **not rewriting the entire role** 
 , because the existing responsibilities are already very growth\-oriented. I would change the title to
 **Senior Growth Manager** 
 , rewrite the opening around
 **ownership of Bazaar.in's growth** 
 , and add the dedicated
 **Growth Strategy \& Execution** 
 section so candidates understand that this person is expected to
 *decide what should drive growth and then make it happen* 
 , rather than simply manage separate sales and marketing activities.

**Title:** 
**Manager II, IT Delivery**
 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization.
   

  

 Fueled by strategic investment in technology and innovation, Client Technology seeks to drive growth opportunities and solve complex business problems for our clients through building a robust platform for business and powerful product engine that are vital to innovation at scale. As part of Client Technology, you’ll work with technologists and business experts, blending EY’s deep industry knowledge and innovative ideas with our platforms, capabilities, and technical expertise. As a catalyst for change and growth, you’ll be at the forefront of integrating emerging technologies from AI to Data Analytics into every corner of what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**EY Technology:**
 Technology has always been at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. We need technology to keep an organization the size of ours working efficiently. We have 250,000 people in more than 140 countries, all of whom rely on secure technology to be able to do their job every single day. Everything from the laptops we use, to the ability to work remotely on our mobile devices and connecting our people and our clients, to enabling hundreds of internal tools and external solutions delivered to our clients. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and is key to us being more innovative as an organization.
   

  

**EY Technology** 
 supports our technology needs through three business units:
   

  

* Client Technology (CT) \- focuses on developing new technology services for our clients. It enables EY to identify new technology\-based opportunities faster and pursue those opportunities more rapidly.
* Enterprise Workplace Technology (EWT) – EWT supports our Core Business Services functions and will deliver fit\-for\-purpose technology infrastructure at the cheapest possible cost for quality services. EWT will also support our internal technology needs by focusing on a better user experience.
* Information Security (Info Sec) \- Info Sec prevents, detects, responds and mitigates cyber\-risk, protecting EY and client data, and our information management systems.


**The opportunity**
 The Manager, IT Delivery role manages and leads a team of technical support staff who design, develop, test, implement, and monitor software and tools; works with business leaders to define scope and requirements, and plans and executes the development of various systems; and acts as liaison with business sponsors and principals, while leading cross\-functional teams, managing project risks and resources, and integrating cybersecurity best practices to ensure secure and successful project delivery.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Responsible for delivering software releases relating to the product for the business units. Works with business clients to determine scope, and develops environmental requirements for each project.
* Works closely with management to develop and implement staffing and operational plans. Participates in the development of short and long term department goals. Monitors and reports on service delivery metrics and overall performance.
* Develops and implements changes to department policies and procedures to meet changing business needs and to achieve department objectives. Identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Leads quality initiatives to improve the delivery of service levels. Works with senior management in the planning, development, and execution of short and long range goals.
* Presents status, metrics, and department initiatives at meetings with management and project peers. Maintains relationships with technical teams, IT, and business partners.
* Participates in the development of the department budget. Reviews expenses and ensures department operates within budgetary guidelines.
* Ensures staff complies with information technology and information security policies and procedures, and verifies that deliverables meet requirements.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.
* Lead cross\-functional teams, fostering collaboration and effectively communicating project progress and updates to stakeholders.
* Identify potential risks throughout the project lifecycle and implement strategies to mitigate them, ensuring smooth project delivery.
* Develop comprehensive project plans, set timelines, allocate resources efficiently, and manage budgets to ensure successful project delivery.
* Enhance cybersecurity frameworks by integrating advanced security measures and best practices into IT projects to safeguard company data and assets.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* A team player with strong analytical, communication and interpersonal skills
* Constantly updating yourself about new technologies in the market
* A winning personality and the ability to become a trusted advisor to the stakeholders
* A technically orietnted leader who is familiar with AWS, CI/CD Pipelines (Github) TDD/BDD practices, user level understanding of Splunk, Honeycomb. Familiarity leading a MS Dynamics team is a plus.
* Familiarity with Claude Code, Github Co\-Pilot is a plus

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a senior Oracle NetSuite Functional SME / Implementation Lead to lead a new, end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation.
   

  

 The consultant will serve as the primary functional point of contact and work closely with business users, finance and accounting teams, senior leadership, technical teams, implementation partners and other project stakeholders.

 This is a hands\-on functional role requiring ownership of the implementation lifecycle from discovery and requirements gathering through configuration, testing, data migration, production cutover and go\-live.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Lead discovery workshops with finance, procurement, sales, project management and business stakeholders to understand current processes, requirements, pain points and future\-state objectives.
   

  

 Perform current\-state and future\-state process analysis, fit\-gap assessments and functional solution design.
   

  

 Lead functional implementation across NetSuite Core Financials, General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Cash Management, Fixed Assets, P2P, O2C, Project Management and Project Accounting.
   

  

 Evaluate NetSuite modules and SuiteApps and recommend appropriate functional solutions.

 Chart of Accounts
   

  

 Accounting Calendars
   

  

 Subsidiaries and Legal Entities
   

  

 Departments and Locations
   

  

 Customers and Vendors
   

  

 Tax Structures
   

  

 Approval Workflows
   

  

 Payment Processes
   

  

 Financial Controls

 Plan and lead Conference Room Pilots (CRP), System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and end\-user training.
   

  

 Track defects, coordinate resolution and ensure business readiness for go\-live.
   

  

 Develop and manage the production cutover plan and support go\-live and post\-production stabilization.
   

  

 Evaluate NetSuite mobile and tablet capabilities for executives, project managers, site personnel, approvers and other field users.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to streamline and automate financial, procurement, billing, project accounting and operational processes using NetSuite capabilities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 8\+ years of hands\-on functional experience with Oracle NetSuite ERP.
   

  

 Proven experience leading at least one brand\-new, end\-to\-end NetSuite implementation or major ERP\-to\-NetSuite migration.
   

  

**Strong Functional Expertise Across**
 Core Financials
   

  

 Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P)
   

  

 Order\-to\-Cash (O2C)
   

  

 Project Management
   

  

 Project Accounting
   

  

 Hands\-on experience configuring NetSuite financial modules, workflows, approval hierarchies, roles, dashboards, reports and saved searches.
   

  

 Experience conducting discovery sessions, requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, functional configuration, testing, data conversion and production cutover.
   

  

 Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial controls and month\-end/year\-end closing processes.
   

  

 Experience working with business stakeholders, implementation partners, technical teams and senior leadership.
   

  

 Strong communication, documentation, presentation and project leadership skills.
   

  

 Willingness to work from the Hyderabad Financial District office 3 days per week during the initial implementation phase.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
 CA, CMA, MBA Finance, Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
   

  

 Strong knowledge of Indian GST, TDS, statutory accounting and regulatory reporting requirements.
   

  

 Oracle NetSuite certifications.
   

  

 Experience implementing NetSuite for construction, real estate, engineering, infrastructure or other project\-based organizations.
   

  

**Knowledge Of Construction\-specific Processes Such As**
 Project budgeting
   

  

 Subcontractor management
   

  

 Site procurement
   

  

 Progress billing
   

  

 Retention
   

  

 Project costing
   

  

 Project profitability reporting
   

  

 Experience with NetSuite SuiteApps, mobile applications, tablet\-based approvals and field\-user solutions.
   

  

 Understanding of NetSuite integrations, SuiteCloud, SuiteFlow, SuiteAnalytics, REST/SOAP services and data migration tools.
   

  

 Ideal Candidate
   

  

 The successful candidate will be a hands\-on NetSuite functional leader who can understand accounting and operational requirements, recommend practical solutions and take ownership of the implementation from discovery through production stabilization.

 This is not a traditional digital marketing role. This is a client\-facing Growth and Campaign Operations role where you will own and execute campaigns (awareness, engagement, conversion) across Meta (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp), Email, Linkedin and Google.
   

  

 Additionally, you would also be responsible to first\-hand drive operations for our program management services, which would be upsold to our existing client base.

 3–7 years
   

  

**▸ Location:** 
 Hyderabad, 5 days WFO

 Growth, Campaign Operations \& Client Success

 Plan, set up and execute omni\-channel campaigns for multiple clients simultaneously and building relevant customer automation journeys.
   

  

**▸ Track \& Report:** 
 Pull campaign reports, track key metrics — open rates, click rates, conversion rates — and present performance summaries to clients on a regular basis.

 Based on performance data, suggest and implement improvements — audience segmentation, message timing, content tweaks and campaign sequencing.
   

  

**▸ Client Coordination:** 
 Work directly with clients to understand their campaign goals, collect content and approvals, and ensure campaigns go live on time without delays.
   

  

**▸ Grow Client Accounts:** 
 Identify growth opportunities within existing client accounts for new use cases, new campaign types, new audience segments and drive adoption.

 Become the internal expert on various Marketing channels and understand how they weave into WhatsApp as a central system for qualification, nurturing and conversion consistently.

 3–7 years in campaign management, performance marketing or growth roles — client\-side or agency.
   

  

**▸ Data \& Reporting:** 
 Comfortable pulling reports, building dashboards and presenting campaign performance data to clients or internal stakeholders.
   

  

**▸ Client Handling:** 
 Experience working directly with clients — managing expectations, collecting inputs and delivering results on time.
   

  

**▸ Analytical Mindset:** 
 You look at numbers and ask why — not just what. Conversion analysis and campaign optimisation excite you.
   

  

**▸ Plus:** 
 Experience in B2B marketing, conversational commerce, WhatsApp API platforms or SaaS growth is a strong advantage.
   

  

**Why ZoTok?**
 At ZoTok you will work at the cutting edge of WhatsApp commerce, running campaigns that directly impact client revenue and business outcomes. You will own growth for real businesses, see your work convert into orders and have a direct line of sight from campaign to revenue.
   

  

 Fast\-growing startup. Real ownership. A niche product with tremendous demand. Join us and be part of something truly extraordinary.

title: Customer Success Coordination Manager [T500-29569]
description:
**About Guidant Global:** 




 Guidant Global delivers dynamic, tailored workforce solutions that empower businesses to thrive in ever\-evolving markets. Through our MSP, RPO, Direct Sourcing, Services Procurement and Consulting services, we help organizations find, engage, and manage the best permanent and contingent talent across the globe.
 



 Part of Impellam Group, we champion A Better Way, a people\-first approach that integrates deep industry expertise with advanced technology. Our technology turns workforce complexity into clarity, with real\-time insights that support smarter talent decisions at scale.
 



 With over 1\.5 million STEM and professional experts in our network across 80\+ countries, we don't just solve today's challenges. We're helping to shape the workforce of tomorrow.
 



  





**About Guidant Global India:** 




 At Guidant Global India, we play our part in shaping the future of work by powering recruitment and support services for Guidant teams across APAC and wider global markets. As a strategic delivery hub and global capability centre, we partner with stakeholders worldwide to raise quality, strengthen compliance, and deliver consistently at scale.
 



 We're not standing still. We're building deeper capability in\-house, taking ownership of the work that matters most, and designing an agile, future\-ready delivery model built for where the business is heading next.
 



 Join us, and you'll be part of a people\-first team that's expert, ambitious, and collaborative, delivering A Better Way, every day.
 



  





**About the Talent Management Team:** 




 Talent Management spans the full external workforce lifecycle \- from sourcing and recruitment through to compliance, onboarding, and candidate care. In this function, you will work across a range of specialist disciplines: sourcing and screening candidates across global markets, managing pre\-employment screening and right\-to\-work compliance, coordinating contractor onboarding and documentation, supporting supply chain and audit activity, and maintaining the data integrity that underpins every placement. Roles include Recruiter, Senior Recruiter, Recruiter Team Leader, Compliance Coordinator, and Operations Coordinator \- with scope to specialize in recruitment delivery, compliance and PES, or operational coordination depending on your background. Operating from the Hyderabad GCC, you will work closely with onshore account teams and hiring managers across UK\&I, Europe, Americas, and Asia\-Pacific, contributing to service standards that matter to real clients in real time. If you want to build expertise across the talent and compliance lifecycle and grow in a structured, performance\-driven environment, Talent Management is where that journey starts.
 



  





**Position Objective:** 



* To lead the offshore Coordinator team, ensuring requisition administration, interview scheduling, feedback capture and candidate/offer control activity is delivered accurately, consistently and within SLA
* Supporting the account to hit Client SLAs across ATS/CRM data quality, interview turnaround and escalation resolution time, acting as the first point of leadership for the offshore Coordinator team



  





**Commitment to Our Culture, Values, and Behaviours:** 



* By being the ambassador for our values and contributing to a culture of trust, pushing boundaries, taking ownership, creating impact and staying human.
* Treating people with respect and by the company's equal opportunity and unacceptable behaviour policy.
* Behaving in a manner that does not put the safety and integrity of you, others, the environment, or the company at risk.



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**Team Leadership \& People Management:** 



* Lead, coach and performance\-manage the offshore Coordinator team (Specialist Recruitment Coordinators and Early Careers Coordinator)
* Plan and manage workload and rota allocation across the team to meet peak demand and assessment/cohort cycles
* Onboard and train new Coordinators, ensuring a consistent understanding of process, governance and systems
* Conduct regular 1:1s, quality checks and performance reviews with team members.



  





**Quality \& Governance Oversight:** 



* Own end\-to\-end QA of interview feedback governance, requisition management and candidate/ATS records across the team
* Set and maintain coordination standards, templates and best\-practice guidance for the offshore team
* Monitor SLA/KPI performance for the Coordinator team, identifying trends and risks
* Report on team performance and quality metrics to the Delivery Lead.



  





**Escalation \& Stakeholder Collaboration:** 



* Act as the first point of escalation for complex or sensitive queries before they reach the onshore Specialist Recruitment Business Partner or Early Careers Lead
* Liaise with the Delivery Lead and onshore Specialist Recruitment Business Partners / Early Careers Lead on process changes, requisition updates and continuous improvement
* Represent the offshore Coordinator team in governance and performance discussions
* Any other duties as reasonably requested by the Line Manager



  





**Workplace Health, Safety, and Environmental Compliance:** 




 At Impellam, it is our moral obligation to safeguard each other, our customers, our temporary workforce, and the environment by operating an injury\-free, healthy workplace that minimizes our environmental impact.
 



 Impellam is committed to providing a safe and secure working environment to all employees and promote best practices.
 



 You will meet our WHSE obligations by committing to:
 


* Seek to prevent injury to any employee, customer, worker, or contractor
* Actively participating and completing compliance training as required
* Consider the safety implications of decisions.



  





**Work Experience and Attributes** 




**Essential:** 




 Proven experience in a recruitment coordination or RPO administrative environment, with some team leadership or supervisory experience
 


* Strong working knowledge of ATS/CRM systems and candidate database management
* Strong organizational and workload\-planning skills, able to manage a team across multiple requisition types simultaneously
* Confident communicator, comfortable coaching colleagues and liaising with onshore stakeholders
* High attention to detail and a process\-led, quality\-first approach
* Prior experience leading or supervising a coordination/administrative team within an RPO or offshore delivery environment
* Good understanding of the Microsoft Office Suite of tools



  





**Desired:** 



* Understanding of GDPR and candidate data\-handling compliance requirements



 Experience with continuous improvement or process design initiatives

title: Service Delivery Lead (AMS)
description:
Mivada is seeking a high\-performing Service Delivery Lead to champion the end\-to\-end success of our Application Managed Services (AMS) portfolio. You will become the trusted advisor to a portfolio of post\-implementation customers, driving strategic outcomes, operational excellence, and long\-term partnership value. You will serve as the operational backbone of our service management function, ensuring dependable, scalable, and measurable service delivery aligned with ITIL best practices. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of customer success, delivery governance, and team leadership.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Success \& Delivery Excellence

 Engagement Management
   

  

* Change Request: Scope, plan, and govern small\-scale project work and ongoing enhancements within your accounts.
* Enhancements: Scope, plan, and oversee small\-scale projects, enhancements, and service improvements within client accounts.


 Leadership \& Collaboration
   

  

* Operational Orchestration: Maintain a single consolidated view of account KPIs, budgets, risks, and reporting across your portfolio.
* Service Efficiency: Drive high\-velocity ticket resolution and enforce operational standards across the AMS team.


 People Leadership:
   

  

* Lead and mentor a young, diverse, and ambitious global AMS team, creating clarity, structure, and growth pathways.
* Build a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement.
* Coach team members on managing escalations, prioritising workloads, and refining their consulting skills.
* Maintain effective communication rhythms, handover processes, and aligned expectations across time zones.

 Everyone who joins our team is treated as a trusted member of the team, not a number. Ultimately your success is our success, so we invest in our People heavily. Here are the top reasons to join us:

title: Manager, Customer Success
description:
**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 The Senior Manager of Customer Success will build and lead the Customer Success team in Seismic's India hub, supporting a high\-volume book of business through scaled digital engagement. This role creates a strong team culture and drives consistent customer engagement, adoption, risk management, renewal readiness, and value realization at scale.
   

  

 This leader will collaborate with Customer Success leadership and Seismic's Customer Experience organization (Community, Customer Education, Programs, and Operations) to translate Seismic's global strategy into regular team execution, with a focus on using AI and automation to streamline workflows, scale customer touchpoints, and increase team productivity. The role also serves as an escalation point for internal teams and customers, representing Seismic to both.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* 8\+ years in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Renewals, or any B2B SaaS post\-sales role.
* 3\+ years managing Customer Success Managers or post\-sales teams, preferably in B2B SaaS.
* Managed teams overseeing adoption, retention, value realization, risk mitigation, and executive engagement.
* Strong understanding of Customer Success operating metrics, including customer health, adoption, GRR, NRR, churn risk, renewal readiness, and forecast hygiene.
* Experience working in a global SaaS organization across regions, cultures, and time zones.


**What you’ll be doing:**
**Who you are:**
* You are an experienced people leader with a track record of managing and developing Customer Success teams.
* You set clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations for distributed teams.
* You understand how customer adoption, value realization, risk management, and renewal readiness support retention.
* You work effectively across Sales, Renewals, Services, Support, Product, and Operations.
* You are comfortable representing the Customer Success function with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders.


**What you will be doing:**
* Lead and develop a team of Customer Success Managers and Renewals Specialist in Seismic’s India hub, ensuring the team meets customer satisfaction and retention targets.
* Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high\-performing Customer Success team in India, including performance management, career development, and building a culture of accountability and continuous improvement. Establish operating rhythms and management routines that drive measurable improvements across customer engagement, adoption, risk mitigation, renewal readiness, and customer value. Serve as an escalation resource for CSMs, internal teams, and customers, resolving escalations within defined SLAs and improving customer outcomes.
* Partner cross\-functionally to remove blockers, improve CSM effectiveness, and represent Customer Success with customers and prospects.
* Evolve Seismic's Digital Customer Success program at the India hub in partnership with CS leadership and the CX organization (Community, Customer Education, Programs, Operations) by surfacing gaps, contributing improvements, and shaping the regional operating model.
* Own the health, renewal forecast, and risk pipeline for the book of business, ensuring forecast accuracy, early identification of risk themes, and clear escalation paths.


**What we have for you:**
 At Seismic, we’re committed to providing benefits and perks for the whole self. To explore our benefits available in each country, please visit the Global Benefits page.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
   

  

 Please be aware we have noticed an increase in hiring scams potentially targeting Seismic candidates. Read our full statement on our Careers page.

title: BD & Marketplace Growth Lead
description:
**BD \& Marketplace Growth Lead** 




 📍 Hyderabad \| Full\-time
 



  





**A Note from the Founders** 




 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.
 



 Products get listed, sales happen, campaigns run — but very few people truly think about how brands scale profitably over time.
 



 At SkinBae, we are building this differently.
 



 We are looking for someone who naturally thinks in terms of:
 


* growth opportunities
* revenue ownership
* category leadership
* profitability, not just sales



 This role is not about simply managing marketplaces. It is about building scalable growth engines across platforms and helping Korean beauty brands grow meaningfully in India.
 



 If you enjoy numbers, strategy, negotiations, and ownership, you’ll enjoy being here.
 



  





**About SkinBae** 




 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.
 



 We are scaling rapidly across marketplaces, and this role will directly influence how brands grow across Amazon, Nykaa, TIRA, Myntra, quick commerce, and future channels.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 This is a revenue ownership role focused on driving marketplace growth, profitability, and brand scale.
 



 You will own platform growth strategy, revenue performance, marketplace expansion, and brand scaling across a portfolio of Korean beauty brands.
 



 You will work closely with listings, operations, marketing, and leadership teams to ensure strategy translates into measurable business growth.
 



  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**1\. Marketplace P\&L \& Revenue Ownership** 



* Own GMV, revenue, and contribution margins across marketplaces
* Drive monthly and quarterly growth targets
* Balance growth and profitability through commercial decisions
* Monitor overall business health across platforms



  





**2\. Platform\-Wise Growth Strategy** 



* Build marketplace\-specific growth strategies:
* Amazon → scale and performance
* Nykaa → visibility and brand growth
* TIRA → premium positioning
* Myntra → category expansion

**3\. Brand Scaling \& Portfolio Strategy** 



* Prioritize brands based on market opportunity and performance

**4\. Commercial Strategy \& Negotiation** 



* Lead discussions around:
* Margins

* Marketing spends

**5\. Demand Creation \& Visibility Planning** 



* Plan marketplace campaigns and sale participation
* Improve visibility through banners, ranking, and promotions
* Align marketing spends with conversion and revenue outcomes

**6\. Data \& Performance Analytics** 



* Track:
* GMV growth
* Conversion rates
* Platform\-wise sales
* ROI on spends
* Discount dependency
* Use insights to improve:
* Pricing
* Margins
* SKU performance
* Revenue contribution



  





**7\. New Channel Expansion** 



* Identify and onboard new marketplaces
* Explore quick commerce channels:
* Blinkit
* Zepto
* Instamart
* Build diversified revenue streams across channels



  





**8\. Cross\-Functional Execution Ownership** 



* Coordinate with:
* Listings team
* Operations team
* Marketing \& influencer teams
* Finance and leadership
* Ensure strategy execution aligns with revenue goals
* Maintain inventory readiness during campaigns and launches



  





**Key KPIs (Non\-Negotiable)** 



* Monthly GMV growth
* Contribution margin improvement
* ROI on marketing spends
* Platform\-wise revenue mix
* Brand\-wise growth contribution
* New channel revenue contribution
* Category ranking improvements
* Marketplace profitability



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  





**Mindset** 



* Owner mindset with strong business thinking
* Strong bias toward numbers and outcomes
* Ability to make decisions under ambiguity
* High accountability and execution focus



  





**Experience** 




**4–7 years in:** 



* Marketplace growth
* E\-commerce business management
* Category management
* Business development



 Experience handling revenue ownership and marketplace scaling is essential.
 



  





**Skills** 



* Strong commercial and negotiation skills
* Understanding of marketplace ecosystems
* Data\-driven decision\-making ability

* Amazon, Nykaa, Myntra, TIRA ecosystems

 You will play a key role in building SkinBae’s marketplace business across India. As the company grows, this role will expand into larger business ownership across categories, brands, and revenue channels.

1. Initial conversation

title: Strategic Alliance Manager (Location-Bangalore, Hyderabad)
description:
**About the company** 




 At StudyIn, we believe that the right guidance has the power to change lives. As the world’s most trusted higher education specialist, we’ve helped over 1\.3 million students access study opportunities since 2006, placing them at top universities across the UK, USA, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and Dubai. Our global team of 500\+ professionals spans 40\+ countries worldwide, offering expert counselling, admissions support, visa guidance, and university partnerships.
 



  





**Main Duties \& Scope of the role** 




 The Strategic Alliance Manager is responsible for driving hyperlocal brand visibility, institutional engagement, and student lead generation for StudyIn within their assigned territory. This role acts as a vital link between central marketing and local on\-ground execution, ensuring campaigns translate effectively into branch\-level growth and conversions.
 



 The ideal candidate is a high\-energy, execution\-focused professional who excels at building relationships with schools, colleges, and coaching centers, whilst seamlessly managing community events and B2B partner engagement to boost student walk\-ins and applications.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Institutional Partnerships \& Relationship Management** 



* **Strategic Outreach:** 
 Identify and build long\-term relationships with schools, colleges, coaching institutes, and language academies within target catchment areas to strengthen regional presence.
* **Partnership Activation:** 
 Activate and nurture key institutional accounts through well\-defined engagement plans and continuous follow\-through.
* **Account Planning:** 
 Maintain a structured pipeline of institutional partners, mapping their academic calendars to ensure timely and relevant engagement activities.



**2\. Local Demand \& Lead Generation** 



* **Outreach Initiatives:** 
 Plan, coordinate, and execute a range of student outreach initiatives, including seminars, workshops, and webinars within partner institutions.
* **Event Management:** 
 Organise and drive student participation for branch\-level events, in\-house education fairs, and university delegate visits.
* **Activity Calendar:** 
 Calendarize the local city\-level activities and monthly outreach schedules to ensure consistent market presence and efficient resource deployment.



**3\. Hyperlocal Marketing Execution** 



* **Identify Local Branding Opportunities:** 
 Identify local branding opportunities including standees, posters, kiosks and outdoor branding.
* **Offline Visibility Campaigns:** 
 Coordinate branch\-level offline visibility campaigns near coaching hubs and educational clusters.
* **Tactical Activations:** 
 Support local promotions and tactical activations to increase walk\-ins (e.g., experiential pop\-ups and student networking sessions).
* **Social Amplification:** 
 Act as the social media champion for the local branch, capturing high\-quality content and student testimonials during events for digital amplification.



**4\. Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Reporting** 



* **Sales Alignment:** 
 Work collaboratively with the Branch Manager Sales and counselling teams to ensure seamless lead handovers, timely follow\-ups, and a cohesive student conversion journey.
* **Budget \& ROI Tracking:** 
 Manage the assigned outreach budget efficiently, tracking the return on investment (ROI) and effectiveness of all local marketing activities.
* **Data \& CRM Hygiene:** 
 Ensure all event records, partner contacts, and performance metrics (lead volume, event participation) are accurately maintained within the CRM system.



  





**About the Candidate (including required competencies)** 



* **Relationship Management:** 
 Proven capability to network with senior stakeholders, institutional heads, and academic partners.
* **Execution \& Autonomy:** 
 Strong event coordination skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple engagements in a fast\-paced environment.
* **Public Speaking:** 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the confidence to deliver engaging seminars to large student audiences.
* **Commercial Acumen:** 
 Result\-oriented mindset with a clear focus on data, performance reporting, and pipeline metrics.



  





**Requirements \& Qualification** 



* **Education:** 
 University degree required; a Master’s degree or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.
* **Experience:** 
 3–8 years of experience in field marketing, institutional sales, educational partnerships, or business development.
 *(Experience within the international education, study abroad, or EdTech sectors is highly desirable)* 
 .
* **Mobility \& Local Expertise:** 
 Must be highly mobile, well\-versed with the geography of the local city, and fluent in the local language. Willingness to travel frequently within the designated territory is essential.

 \* Partner satisfaction and relationship health.
 



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  





 We are looking for someone who combines education credibility, storytelling ability and commercial drive.
 



  





 Essential
