 \* Strong understanding of the Indian school ecosystem.
 



 \* Existing relationships with school owners, principals, trustees or academic leaders will be highly valued.
 



 \* Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
 



 \* Strong consultative selling and business development capability.
 



 \* Confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
 



 \* Ability to understand needs, influence decisions and close opportunities.
 



 \* Good understanding of pedagogy, curriculum, school operations and technology adoption.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively across India.
 



 \* Strong digital awareness and willingness to learn about AI and emerging technologies.
 



 \* Laptop mandatory.
 



  





 The Person We Are Looking For
 



  





 You could be an education professional, curriculum leader, EdTech professional, school solutions specialist, consultant, institutional sales professional or school leader.
 



  





 More importantly, you are:
 



  





 A Storyteller
 



 You can take an idea and make people see its possibility.
 



  





 A Relationship Builder
 



 People trust you and are willing to open doors for you.
 



  





 A Consultative Seller
 



 You listen first, understand the problem and then create the right proposition.
 



  





 A Commercial Thinker
 



 You understand that relationships must ultimately translate into opportunities, partnerships and revenue.
 



  





 An Education Insider
 



 You understand how schools operate, how decisions are made and what matters to education leaders.
 



  





 An AI \& Innovation Enthusiast
 



 You are curious about how AI and emerging technologies can reshape education and can communicate these possibilities to non\-technical audiences.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 The successful person will become a trusted education advisor and a strong commercial representative of Dreamtime Learning — someone who can open doors, create meaningful conversations, build conviction, and ultimately turn those relationships into successful school partnerships.
 



  





 If you can build the relationship, tell the story, create the opportunity and close the partnership — we want to hear from you.

title: Customer Success & Onboarding Specialist – AI SaaS
description:
**Role:** 
 Customer Success and Onboarding Specialist
 



**Company:** 
 StepsAI
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Experience:** 
 1–3 years preferred
 



  





**About StepsAI** 




  





 StepsAI builds AI agents that help businesses sell, support, capture leads, book appointments, recommend products, answer questions and automate customer conversations.
 



  





 Our agents work across channels including websites, Shopify, WhatsApp, Instagram and other customer touchpoints.
 



  





 We are looking for someone who can help every new StepsAI customer get set up properly, see value quickly and continue getting better results over time.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 This is a customer\-facing role combining
 **Customer Success, Onboarding, and Implementation** 




  





**Technical Support** 
 .
 


1. You will own the early customer journey.
2. When a customer signs up, you will understand their business, identify what they want the AI agent to accomplish, configure the agent, connect the required channels, test it thoroughly and help them go live.



  





 But your job doesn't end at onboarding.
 



  





 You will continue to monitor how the agent is performing, talk to the customer, identify areas for improvement, tune the setup and make sure they are getting real value from StepsAI.
 



  





**Customer happiness is the highest priority.** 




  





 We want customers to feel that there is someone at StepsAI who understands their business and genuinely wants them to succeed.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Customer Onboarding** 




  





 Own the onboarding process from signup to successful go\-live.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Conduct approximately
 **5–6 customer onboarding sessions per day** 
 .
* Understand each customer's business, customers, goals and use cases.
* Identify what they want their AI agent to accomplish.
* Help customers set up their StepsAI account.
* Build and configure AI agents based on their business requirements.
* Train the agent using their website, product information, FAQs, documents and other business knowledge.
* Configure instructions, workflows and agent behaviour.
* Test the agent before launch.
* Help customers understand how to use the StepsAI platform.
* Make sure every customer has a clear path to going live.



  





 The objective is not simply to complete an onboarding call.
 



  





 The objective is to get the customer to their
 **first successful outcome as quickly as possible.** 




  





**Build \& Configure AI Agents** 




  





 You will work hands\-on with StepsAI to create effective agents for customers.
 



  





 This may include:
 


* Understanding the customer's business and customer journey.
* Identifying the most important questions customers ask.
* Structuring the right knowledge for the agent.
* Configuring agent instructions and behaviour.
* Setting up lead\-capture flows.
* Setting up product recommendation flows.
* Setting up customer\-support workflows.
* Configuring appointment or meeting booking.
* Setting up order\-tracking experiences.
* Configuring automation and workflows.
* Testing different customer questions and scenarios.
* Identifying gaps in the agent's responses.
* Continuously tuning the agent for better performance.



 You should enjoy experimenting until the agent works well.
 



  





**Integrations \& Channel Setup** 




  





 Help customers connect StepsAI to the channels and tools they already use.
 



 Depending on the customer, this could include:
 



  





**Websites** 



* WordPress
* Custom websites
* Other website platforms



  





**E\-commerce** 



* Shopify
* WooCommerce



  





**Messaging \& Social** 



* WhatsApp
* Instagram
* Facebook / Messenger



  





 You do not need to be a software engineer.
 



  





 But you should be
 **technically curious and comfortable learning how integrations work.** 




  





**Troubleshooting \& Customer Support** 




  





 You will be one of the first people customers contact when something isn't working.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Understand the problem clearly.
* Reproduce issues whenever possible.
* Identify whether the issue comes from configuration, data, integration or the product.
* Solve problems that can be handled directly.
* Guide customers through fixes.
* Escalate product or engineering issues with clear documentation.
* Coordinate with the technical team until the issue is resolved.
* Keep the customer updated throughout the process.
* Follow up after resolution to ensure everything is working properly.



  





 We care about
 **ownership** 
 , not simply forwarding tickets.
 



  





 If a customer has a problem, you should feel responsible for making sure it reaches a resolution.
 



  





**Customer Success** 




  





 Onboarding is only the beginning.
 



  





 After customers go live, you will proactively check how things are going.
 



  





**You will:** 



* Touch base with customers regularly.
* Understand whether StepsAI is achieving what they expected.
* Review conversations and agent performance.
* Identify unanswered or poorly answered questions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the agent.
* Recommend new features or workflows that could help them.
* Help customers adopt more of the platform.
* Identify customers who are not using the product effectively.
* Proactively reach out before customers become unhappy.
* Celebrate customer wins and understand what created them.



  





 Your goal is to move customers from:
 



  





**"We bought StepsAI."** 




 to:
 



**"StepsAI is actually helping our business."** 




  





**Monitor \& Improve Agent Performance** 




  





 AI agents need continuous improvement.
 



  





 You will regularly review how customer agents are performing and ask:
 


* Are questions being answered correctly?
* Where is the agent getting confused?
* What questions are customers asking repeatedly?
* Are leads being captured properly?
* Are products being recommended appropriately?
* Are integrations working correctly?
* Are workflows triggering as expected?
* Where are conversations dropping off?
* What additional knowledge should be added?
* What can we change to create a better customer experience?



  





 You will make changes and recommendations based on what you observe.
 



  





**Be the Voice of the Customer** 




  





 You will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams.
 



  





 You will:
 


* Collect recurring customer feedback.
* Identify common onboarding problems.
* Identify recurring bugs.
* Document feature requests.
* Surface friction in the product.
* Explain customer use cases to the product team.
* Identify opportunities to simplify onboarding.
* Suggest features or improvements based on real customer behaviour.



  





 Because you will speak with customers every day, you will have some of the best insights in the company about what customers actually need.
 



  





 We expect you to share them.
 



  





**Improve Our Systems** 




  





 We don't just want you to follow the onboarding process.
 



  





 We want you to help us
 **improve it** 
 .
 



  





 If 20 customers ask the same question, we shouldn't answer it manually 20 times forever.
 



  





 You will help us create:
 


* Better onboarding checklists.
* Standard implementation templates.
* Industry\-specific agent templates.
* Setup guides.
* FAQs.
* Troubleshooting guides.
* Video tutorials.
* Customer training material.
* Internal documentation.
* Standard operating procedures.
* Better follow\-up processes.
* Customer health tracking.
* Automated onboarding wherever appropriate.



  





 The goal is to make every future customer easier to onboard and more successful than the previous one.
 



  





**What a Typical Customer Journey Might Look Like** 




  





 A Shopify brand signs up for StepsAI.
 



  





 You:
 



**1\. Understand the business** 




 What do they sell?
 



 Who are their customers?
 



 What do they want StepsAI to accomplish?
 



**2\. Build the agent** 




 Train it on their products, policies, FAQs and website.
 



 Configure how it should respond.
 



 Set up product recommendations, support and lead\-capture use cases.
 



**3\. Connect the channels** 




 Install StepsAI on Shopify.
 



 Connect WhatsApp or Instagram if required.
 



 Test everything.
 



**4\. Go live** 




 Make sure the customer understands the platform and feels confident using it.
 



**5\. Monitor** 




 Review real conversations and performance.
 



**6\. Improve** 




 Tune responses, fix gaps and recommend improvements.
 



**7\. Follow up** 




 Talk to the customer and understand whether they are seeing value.
 



 That's the role.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 We're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers.
 



  





 You should be:
 



  





**Customer\-obsessed** 




 You care whether the customer actually succeeds.
 



 You don't think:
 



*"I finished my call."* 




 You think:
 



*"Did this customer get what they needed?"* 




  





**A strong communicator** 




 You should be comfortable speaking with business owners, marketers, e\-commerce teams and non\-technical customers.
 



 You should be able to explain technical concepts in simple language.
 



  





**A problem solver** 




 When something doesn't work, your first reaction should be:
 



**"Let me figure out why."** 




  





**Technically curious** 




 You don't need to code, but you should be comfortable understanding software, integrations, AI agents, websites and business tools.
 



  





**Organized** 




 You may work with multiple new and existing customers every day.
 



 You should be able to manage onboarding sessions, follow\-ups, open issues and customer commitments without losing track.
 



  





**Proactive** 




 You should not wait for customers to complain.
 



 If you see that something isn't working well, reach out and fix it.
 



  





**Comfortable with a fast\-moving startup** 




 Processes will improve.
 



 Products will change.
 



 New integrations will launch.
 



 New customer use cases will appear.
 



 You should be comfortable learning continuously.
 



  





**Preferred Background** 




  





 We would ideally like someone with
 **1–3 years of experience** 
 in one or more of the following:
 


* Customer Success
* SaaS Customer Onboarding
* Implementation
* Technical Support
* Product Support
* Client Success
* Customer Experience



 Experience with B2B SaaS, e\-commerce, Shopify, WhatsApp, chatbots is a strong advantage.
 



 Fresh graduates with exceptional communication, problem\-solving ability, and technical curiosity may also be considered.
 



  





**Skills That Will Help** 



* Strong customer communication.
* Troubleshooting and problem\-solving.
* Basic understanding of SaaS products.
* Ability to learn technical products quickly.
* Understanding of e\-commerce workflows.
* Familiarity with Shopify or WordPress.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp Business or Meta products.
* Strong documentation skills.
* Comfort working with AI tools.



  





**How Success Will Be Measured** 




  





 We care about both
 **speed and customer outcomes** 
 .
 



  





 Key metrics may include:
 


* Customers onboarded per day.
* Time from signup to go\-live.
* Successful onboarding / activation rate.
* Customer satisfaction after onboarding.
* First response and issue\-resolution time.
* Product and feature adoption.
* Customer engagement after onboarding.



 Agent performance and quality.
 



  





 If you think this role sounds like you,
 **we’d love to hear from you. Apply and tell us why you’d be a great fit for StepsAI.**

title: Renewals Manager
description:
**About Us:**
 Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
   

  

 Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
   

  

**Overview:**
 As a Renewals Manager supporting SMB and Commercial customers, you will own the commercial renewal process for a portfolio of customers, driving predictable retention and identifying opportunities for future growth. Working closely with Customer Success, Sales and cross\-functional partners, you will deliver a seamless renewal experience, proactively manage commercial risk, and help customers realize continued value from their investment in Seismic.
   

  

**Who you are:**
* 3–5 years of experience in Renewals, Account Management, Customer Success, or a related commercial role within a B2B SaaS environment.
* Experience managing a portfolio of SMB or Commercial customers with responsibility for revenue retention.
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to confidently lead customer conversations and achieve successful outcomes.
* Ability to identify expansion opportunities and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams to support customer growth.
* Analytical mindset with experience using customer insights, product usage, and CRM data to inform decisions and prioritize work.
* Experience maintaining accurate forecasts and CRM hygiene using Salesforce or a similar CRM platform.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage a high\-volume portfolio while maintaining attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative approach to working across Sales, Customer Success and Revenue Operations..
* Self\-motivated, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment.


**What you’ll be doing:**
* Own Commercial Renewals: Manage the end\-to\-end renewal process for an assigned portfolio, delivering timely, accurate, and predictable renewal outcomes.
* Drive Retention: Proactively manage renewal plans, identify commercial risks early, and engage customers to maximize retention and long\-term value.
* Build Customer Relationships: Develop trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and position the ongoing value of Highspot.
* Identify Growth Opportunities: Recognize expansion opportunities and partner with Sales, and Customer Success to progress customer growth.
* Lead Commercial Conversations: Manage renewal negotiations and coordinate with internal teams to resolve commercial blockers and deliver successful outcomes.
* Use Data to Drive Decisions: Leverage customer insights, product usage, and commercial data to prioritize renewals, identify risks, and improve portfolio performance.
* Deliver Forecast Excellence: Maintain accurate forecasts, CRM hygiene, and renewal reporting to provide clear visibility into portfolio performance and commercial risk.
* Collaborate Across the Business: Partner with Customer Success, Sales, Revenue Operations, Finance, and Legal to deliver a consistent, customer\-centric renewal experience.
* Drive Operational Excellence: Contribute to scalable renewal processes, best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer outcomes and business performance.


**What we have for you:**

 If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the application or recruiting process, please click here.
   

  

 Seismic is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, age, race, religion, or any other classification which is protected by applicable law.
   

  

 Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

title: Oracle Channel Revenue Management - Manager
description:
The Opportunity
   

  

 Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands\-on learning, cutting\-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
   

  

 As an Oracle Channel Revenue Management Manager, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients optimize operational efficiency through business application consulting. You will analyze client needs, implement Oracle's suite of applications, and provide training and support to validate seamless integration and utilization, enabling clients to achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Digital Core Modernisation practice, you will focus on Oracle's tools designed to manage the entire customer journey, from lead generation to revenue realization and customer satisfaction.
   

  

 As a Manager, you will build meaningful client connections and inspire your teams, navigating complex situations with confidence. You are expected to anticipate the needs of your teams and clients, delivering quality solutions even when the path forward is unclear. You will leverage a broad range of tools and methodologies to generate new ideas and solve problems, using critical thinking to break down complex concepts. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will deepen your understanding of the business context, interpret data to inform insights, and uphold professional and technical standards, contributing to the firm's purpose and values.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and support engagements, spanning sell\-side and buy\-side channel flows from discovery through design, build, test, deployment, and hypercare.
* Own the overall solution design and delivery approach for channel incentive processes, ensuring solutions are scalable, reusable, auditable, and aligned with business requirements, pricing policy, and revenue recognition standards.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, and Finance stakeholders, translating commercial objectives into effective channel program strategies and recommending appropriate program structures, eligibility rules, accrual treatments, and settlement approaches.
* Lead the design and configuration of Customer Channel Management programs, including customer rebates, customer promotion programs, annual and tiered volume programs, customer volume programs, annual co\-op programs, lump sum payments, off\-invoice promotions, special price agreements, and royalty payments.
* Lead the design and configuration of Supplier Channel Management programs, including supplier rebates, supplier annual rebates, ship\-and\-debit programs, supplier claim submission and validation, accrual reconciliation, and Supplier Portal collaboration.
* Govern the design of Deductions and Settlement processes, including claims, deductions, overpayments, invoice deductions, non\-invoice deductions, manual claims, claim investigation, dispute handling, write\-offs, and settlement by credit memo, debit memo, chargeback, check, or Payables payment.
* Oversee configuration of core setup objects including channel settings, channel program types, claim types, claim reasons, claim sources and settlement methods, user statuses, customer trade profiles, supplier trade profiles, approval rules, and claim assignment and ownership rules.
* Provide functional and technical leadership for integrations between Channel Revenue Management and Oracle Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, Inventory, Subledger Accounting, and General Ledger, with a strong understanding of accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting event data flows.
* Lead the design of pricing\-related configuration supporting channel programs, including qualifiers, custom qualifiers, modifiers, price lists, and net\-of\-rebate conditions within Oracle Fusion Pricing.
* Own the accrual and liability management design, including trade fund budgets, fund allocation, accrual creation and adjustment, accrual balances, earnings versus payments reconciliation, pay\-over\-earnings thresholds, and period\-end close support.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, projects, and stakeholder priorities while ensuring agreed quality, scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and deliverables are effectively managed.
* Establish and enforce quality assurance and release management processes, including configuration reviews, unit testing, SIT, UAT, integration testing, regression testing for quarterly Oracle updates, deployment readiness, and post\-deployment monitoring.
* Lead data migration and conversion strategy for programs, accruals, claims, trade profiles, master data, and open transactional balances using FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST services, and other Oracle Cloud data\-loading mechanisms.
* Provide oversight for operational execution of scheduled processes such as accrual generation, claim settlement, mass settle and mass update claims, and accounting event sweeps, and proactively resolve data, integration, configuration, performance, and failed\-processing issues.
* Lead analysis of channel performance and operational metrics, including program effectiveness, accrual accuracy, claim ageing, deduction recovery rates, settlement cycle times, and unclaimed rebate exposure, translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Partner with business and technology teams to define and enhance reporting, dashboards, and KPIs using OTBI, BI Publisher, and analytics platforms to provide visibility into channel program performance and financial exposure.
* Assess new Oracle Channel Revenue Management capabilities delivered through quarterly updates and recommend adoption of features that improve automation, control, scalability, and user experience.
* Establish and maintain solution governance standards, including configuration workbooks, naming conventions, change control, environment management, documentation, and access management.
* Promote appropriate data quality, master data, and control practices across customer, supplier, item, pricing, and program data supporting channel processes.
* Develop standard operating procedures, solution documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, reusable accelerators, and best\-practice frameworks to improve consistency and reduce delivery effort.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, reducing manual claim handling and settlement activities and improving overall efficiency and scalability of channel operations.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex order, pricing, accrual, claim, settlement, and accounting integration issues, coordinating with internal technology teams, Oracle Support, and other stakeholders as required.
* Manage and mentor a team of Associates and Senior Associates, providing technical guidance, work allocation, quality reviews, coaching, performance feedback, and development opportunities.
* Review team deliverables and provide appropriate oversight to ensure implementations meet expected functional, technical, quality, security, and operational standards.
* Facilitate stakeholder meetings, requirement workshops, design and solution reviews, status discussions, issue\-resolution sessions, and leadership updates.
* Communicate project status, risks, dependencies, issues, and recommended mitigation actions clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Support pursuits, proposals, solution demonstrations, estimation, and capability building as required.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Overall experience of 8\-12 years in Oracle applications, with strong hands\-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Channel Revenue Management across at least 2\-3 end\-to\-end implementations or equivalent large\-scale support and enhancement engagements.
* Strong hands\-on configuration experience across Customer Channel Management, Supplier Channel Management, and Deductions and Settlement, including channel settings, program types, claim types, claim reasons, settlement methods, and customer and supplier trade profiles.
* Deep domain understanding of channel incentive processes, including customer and supplier rebate management, trade promotions, accrual management, claims management, deductions and settlement, and indirect sales management.
* Strong understanding of the Order\-to\-Cash and Procure\-to\-Pay process flows and the integration of Channel Revenue Management with Order Management, Pricing, Receivables, Payables, Procurement, and General Ledger.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Pricing, including price lists, qualifiers, modifiers, and custom pricing rules supporting channel programs.
* Understanding of Subledger Accounting, accounting events, accrual accounting, credit and debit memo processing, write\-off treatment, and period\-close implications of channel transactions.
* Experience managing complex implementations involving multiple business stakeholders, Oracle pillars, integrations, and dependencies.
* Demonstrated experience in requirements gathering, fit\-gap analysis, solution design, configuration, data migration, testing, deployment, production support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency in Oracle Cloud data\-loading and integration mechanisms, including FBDI, ADFdi, CSV loaders, REST and SOAP web services, and file\-based integrations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to perform root\-cause analysis and recommend sustainable solutions rather than tactical fixes.
* Experience defining and monitoring operational metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and performance reports for channel and trade processes.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business\-relevant information.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and stakeholders in a dynamic delivery environment.
* Experience leading, mentoring, and developing team members and reviewing technical and functional deliverables.


**Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Experience with adjacent Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules such as Order Management, Global Order Promising, Inventory Management, Procurement, and Supply Chain Financial Orchestration.
* Experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Channel Revenue Management and Trade Management, including chargebacks, third\-party accruals, budgets and offers, and claims, particularly in EBS\-to\-Cloud migration scenarios.
* Industry experience in consumer goods, distribution, high tech, industrial manufacturing, or life sciences where trade promotions, chargebacks, and gross\-to\-net processes are material.
* Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), middleware, EDI transactions, and enterprise integration patterns supporting partner and distributor data exchange.
* Experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, Oracle Analytics Cloud, or comparable reporting and data visualization solutions.
* Understanding of revenue recognition, trade spend governance, financial controls, audit requirements, and segregation\-of\-duties considerations for channel programs.
* Experience with Agile delivery methodologies, including requirements management, sprint planning, backlog management, testing, release management, and defect resolution.
* Oracle Cloud SCM, Order Management, or Channel Revenue Management certifications are desirable.


 Manager\-Level Leadership Expectations
   

  

 The successful candidate will be expected to operate beyond configuration and demonstrate ownership across people, delivery, technology, and stakeholder management. The individual should be able to independently manage complex workstreams, provide direction to delivery teams, challenge and refine requirements, identify risks early, recommend scalable solutions, and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders.
   

  

 The Manager should also contribute to building the capability of the wider team through coaching, knowledge sharing, standardization, reusable solutions, quality governance, and continuous improvement, while maintaining a strong focus on delivery excellence and business outcomes.

title: Relationship Manager
description:
**About 79th East** 




 79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad\-based investment services firm \- an AMFI\-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN\-364145\) and a distributor of Portfolio Management Services (PMS). We work with individuals, families, professionals, business owners and NRIs, and we put client understanding and suitability ahead of sales.
 



**The role** 




 As Relationship Manager you are the client's main point of contact. You will explain mutual funds, PMS and equity in simple language, match products to each client's risk profile, and grow the relationship over years. You will also build business through channel partners and remisiers, and represent the firm in investor\-education webinars and seminars.
 



**Key responsibilities** 



* Acquire new clients and manage an allotted client book across HNI, affluent, professional and NRI segments.
* Explain mutual funds, PMS and equity concepts to clients in simple, clear language.
* Carry out risk profiling and recommend suitable products, with full disclosure of risk, costs and taxation.
* Plan and deliver investor\-education webinars and seminars, and follow up with attendees.
* Hold regular portfolio reviews and grow client relationships through SIPs, fresh investments and referrals.
* Build B2B business through channel partners \- identify, onboard and manage registered MFDs and PMS distributors, with product training, sales support and regular business reviews.
* Coordinate onboarding, KYC and transactions with the operations team.
* Follow AMFI, SEBI and APMI norms at all times \- no mis\-selling, complete documentation.



**What you must bring** 



* Valid NISM Series V\-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) certificate.
* Minimum 2 years' client\-facing experience in mutual funds, PMS, broking or banking investment sales.
* Local candidates only \- you should already be based in Hyderabad and able to travel locally for client meetings.
* Good knowledge of mutual funds, PMS and equity markets.
* Excellent communication, presentation and client\-handling skills.
* Graduate in any discipline.



**Added advantage** 



* NISM Series XXI\-A (PMS Distributors) \- required to distribute PMS; to be obtained after joining if not held.
* NISM Series X\-A and X\-B (Investment Adviser Level 1 and 2\).
* Working knowledge of AI tools such as Claude, used for research, drafting client communication and day\-to\-day productivity.
* Experience in B2B / channel\-partner business, or in managing sub\-brokers or remisiers.
* CFP, CFA or MBA (Finance).
* Proficiency in Telugu and/or Hindi.



**Location and salary** 



* Location: Ameerpet, Hyderabad \- full\-time, on\-site, with local travel for client meetings.
* Salary: up to Rs 4,00,000 per year (CTC), based on experience.



**How to apply** 




 Email your CV to info@79the.com with the subject "RM \- Hyderabad", and mention the validity date of your NISM V\-A certificate. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a discussion.

title: Portfolio Manager
description:
Account Management, Client Relations, Client Retention, Customer Experience, Customer Success, Real Estate
   

  

 Portfolio Manager
   

  

**C$30,000–C$36,000 Annually \| Full\-Time \| Remote \| Eastern Time Hours**
 The Opportunity
   

  

 Royal York Property Management is hiring a Portfolio Manager to manage a portfolio of existing clients, properties, and active service files.
   

  

 You will keep clients informed, monitor rent and account activity, coordinate property services, resolve problems, renew agreements, and protect client relationships.
   

  

 This role requires strong service ownership and sales ability. You must be comfortable handling objections, explaining value, discussing pricing, preventing cancellations, and identifying opportunities to expand client relationships.
   

  

 Direct property\-management experience is preferred but not required. Candidates with strong experience in account management, portfolio management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations are encouraged to apply.
   

  

**What You’ll Own**
* Act as the primary contact for an assigned portfolio of property owners and tenants.
* Manage multiple client accounts, properties, and active service files.
* Complete client onboarding and collect required property, owner, and tenant documents.
* Provide proactive updates about completed work, outstanding issues, and next steps.
* Monitor rent collection and follow up on overdue balances.
* Review monthly property activity before owner payouts, including rent received, fees, expenses, invoices, reserves, and holdbacks.
* Investigate account discrepancies and coordinate corrections with the accounting team.
* Coordinate maintenance requests with internal teams and external service providers.
* Handle owner and tenant complaints, urgent issues, and service escalations.
* Identify dissatisfied or at\-risk clients and take action to prevent avoidable cancellations.
* Manage agreement renewals and discuss pricing or service concerns within company guidelines.
* Handle objections, reinforce the value of the company’s services, and identify appropriate opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Monitor tenant notices, vacancies, turnovers, and re\-leasing activity.
* Maintain accurate CRM notes, documents, tasks, deadlines, and follow\-ups.
* Identify stalled files and escalate financial, legal, or service risks when necessary.
* Use technology and AI tools to improve documentation, communication, reporting, and efficiency.


**What You’ll Need**
* Three or more years of experience in account management, portfolio management, property management, client success, relationship management, sales, or service operations.
* Experience managing multiple clients, accounts, properties, claims, cases, or active files simultaneously.
* Experience with client retention, renewals, objection handling, negotiation, account growth, or consultative sales.
* Experience monitoring rent, invoices, recurring payments, accounts receivable, or overdue balances.
* Confidence reviewing account activity, statements, expenses, and supporting documents.
* Strong client communication and experience handling complaints or escalations.
* Excellent organization, documentation, and follow\-through.
* Experience using a CRM, ticketing system, property\-management platform, or workflow\-management system.
* Ability to coordinate work across internal departments and external providers.
* Strong judgment when managing deadlines, financial concerns, sensitive information, and client expectations.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Availability to work full\-time during Eastern Time business hours.
* Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls.


 Experience in property management, leasing, real estate operations, housing, facilities, insurance, financial services, SaaS, telecommunications, managed services, or another recurring\-service industry will be considered.
   

  

 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 Success means maintaining an organized portfolio, communicating proactively, collecting rent promptly, reviewing property accounts accurately, resolving service issues, securing renewals, protecting client relationships, and supporting portfolio growth.
   

  

 Who Will Succeed
   

  

 The right person takes ownership instead of waiting to be reminded. You are comfortable handling difficult conversations, challenging unclear explanations, negotiating professionally, and coordinating several parties until a problem is fully resolved.
   

  

 You are client\-focused and commercially aware. You know how to protect a relationship without making promises, offering discounts, or bypassing procedures simply to satisfy a client.
   

  

**Compensation**
 The annual compensation range is
 **C$30,000–C$36,000** 
 , based on relevant experience, qualifications, and demonstrated ability.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

 Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you will receive an email with a link to complete a short pre\-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

title: Manager, Customer Service
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 The Manager, Customer Service provides operational leadership for the India\-based Customer Success team within a global, matrixed Customer Success \& Operations organization, with primary responsibility for quote\-to\-order and order\-related customer Success activities. The role oversees the day\-to\-day execution and resolution of customer requests related to quotes, orders, order changes, order status, fulfillment, pricing, and other transactional activities across the customer journey. Working closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Customer Success, the Manager translates global strategy and Success standards into effective local execution, while leading team performance, workforce management, escalations, process adherence, and continuous improvement to drive timely, accurate, and consistent customer outcomes.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Manager, Customer Service Has The Following Responsibilities**

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

title: Retention & Growth Manager
description:
RETENTION \& GROWTH MANAGER \- XTOVIA
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Experience: 2\-5 years
 



 Industry: Beauty \& Haircare / D2C
 



  





 About XTOVIA
 



 Xtovia is a Hyderabad\-based, science\-backed haircare brand reimagining Indian beauty at global standards. Powered by our proprietary TriLayerX bond\-repair technology, Xtovia is building a new generation of high\-performance haircare for Indian hair.
 



 We are a fast\-growing D2C brand building a strong customer community and a long\-term relationship with our customers through product innovation, education and personalised experiences.
 



  





 About the Role
 



 We're looking for a Retention \& Growth Manager to take ownership of the customer lifecycle at Xtovia.
 



 The core focus of this role is retention marketing converting first\-time buyers into repeat customers, increasing customer lifetime value, and building a loyal customer base.
 



 You will work across CRM, customer segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, loyalty, referrals, reactivation and customer engagement. This is a highly hands\-on role where you will be expected to analyse, experiment, execute and learn quickly.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 Customer Retention
 



  





 \-Own and execute Xtovia's retention and repeat\-purchase strategy.
 



 \-Identify opportunities to increase repeat purchase rate, purchase frequency and LTV.
 



 \-Analyse customer behaviour to understand why customers repurchase, churn or become inactive.
 



 \-Build replenishment strategies based on product usage and consumption cycles.
 



 \-Develop cross\-sell and upsell journeys across the product portfolio.
 



 \-Build win\-back strategies for dormant and lapsed customers.
 



  





 CRM \& Lifecycle Marketing
 



  





 \-Own the customer journey from first purchase product experience replenishment repeat purchase loyalty advocacy.
 



 \-Plan and execute campaigns across WhatsApp, Email, SMS and other CRM channels.
 



 \-Build automated journeys for welcome, post\-purchase, product education, replenishment, cross\-sell, upsell, abandoned cart and win\-back.
 



 \-Test different messaging, offers, content, timing and customer segments.
 



 \-Work closely with the content and creative teams to develop high\-performing CRM campaigns.
 



  





 Loyalty \& Community
 



  





 \-Build and manage loyalty and rewards initiatives.
 



 \-Develop referral programs to turn existing customers into acquisition channels.
 



 \-Drive customer reviews, UGC, testimonials and referrals.
 



 \-Create campaigns that build engagement and brand affinity beyond discount\-led marketing.
 



  





 Data \& Experimentation
 



  





 \-Track Repeat Purchase Rate, LTV, Churn, Purchase Frequency, CRM Revenue, AOV and Reactivation Rate.
 



 \-Build customer segments based on purchase behaviour, recency, frequency, product purchased and customer value.
 



 \-Analyse campaign performance and identify growth opportunities.
 



 \-Run A/B tests and continuously optimise the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 What We're Looking For
 



 \-2\-5 years of experience in Retention Marketing, CRM, Lifecycle Marketing, D2C or E\-commerce.
 



 \-Strong understanding of customer lifecycle and retention marketing.
 



 \-Hands\-on experience with WhatsApp, Email, SMS and CRM/marketing automation platforms.
 



 \-Strong analytical skills and comfort working with customer data.
 



 \-Experience with Shopify and D2C analytics is a plus.
 



 \-Experience in beauty, personal care, wellness or consumer brands is preferred.
 



 \-Strong communication and copywriting skills.
 



 \-Someone who enjoys experimenting and finding out what actually makes customers come back.
 



 \-A hands\-on, ownership\-driven startup mindset.
 



  





 What Success Looks Like
 



  





 Your core goal: Turn first\-time customers into repeat customers and repeat customers into loyal Xtovia advocates.
 



  





 You will be responsible for improving: Repeat Purchase Rate \| Customer LTV \| Purchase Frequency \| CRM Revenue \| Reactivation \| Customer Engagement \| Referrals
 



  





 Why Join Xtovia?
 



 \-Work directly with the founding team.
 



 \-Own retention marketing for a fast\-growing Indian haircare brand.
 



 \-Build the CRM, loyalty and customer lifecycle engine from the ground up.
 



 \-Get exposure to D2C growth, consumer behaviour, data and brand building.
 



 \-High ownership, experimentation and learning.
 



  





 Apply
 



 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Work Mode: Full\-Time \| Work From Office
 



 Send your resume to:
 



 levelup@xtovia.com

 Parent Relationship Head

 North \& West, or South \& East (one Senior Manager per zone)

 All Parent Relationship Managers across the zone's campuses

 8–10 years overall, incl. 2–3\+ years in people management

 Graduate; MBA / relevant PG preferred, not mandatory
 



  





**Role Summary**




  





 The Parent Relationship Senior Manager owns parent trust and engagement across every campus in a zone. This is a people\-management role first, and — because parent conversations can be sensitive and emotionally charged — it calls for real maturity too: you will hire, ramp, coach, and review a bench of Parent Relationship Managers, hold the line on the 1:300 mapping ratio as the zone grows, and act as the second\-level escalation point for the harder, trust\-critical conversations a Manager can't close alone.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Zonal ownership** 
 — be accountable for parent trust and NPS across every campus in the zone — not any single campus, all of them
* **People management** 
 — hire, ramp, coach, and review Parent Relationship Managers in the zone, adding headcount as campuses or batch sizes grow so the 1:300 ratio holds
* **Escalation** 
 — pick up anything a Manager can't close on their own — especially sensitive or trust\-critical conversations — and coach Managers on how those are handled
* **Trust oversight** 
 — sample how cases were handled — the tone and the follow\-through, not just closure speed — and hold the expectation\-management standard, not only the SLA
* **Reporting** 
 — consolidate every campus dashboard in the zone into one view, report it to the Parent Relationship Head, and coordinate with Program Ops and the Student Relationship function



  





**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




  





**Zonal parent trust / NPS:** 
 NPS rolled up across all campuses in the zone
 



**2nd\-level escalation TAT:** 
 Time to close issues escalated past the Manager
 



**SLA adherence across zone:** 
 % of managers' concerns closed within SLA
 



**Ratio adherence:** 
 Managers in zone operating at or near 1:300
 



**Manager stability:** 
 Retention of Parent Relationship Managers in the zone
 



  





***Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.***




  





**Who We're Looking For**



* 8–10 years of total experience, with demonstrated people management — has directly managed a team of 5 or more
* Background in a relationship\-, trust\-, or service\-delivery function, ideally one involving sensitive or emotionally\-charged conversations
* Strong escalation handling — stays calm, decisive, and empathetic when an issue is urgent, emotional, or high\-visibility
* A track record of hiring and coaching a frontline team on tone and judgment, not just supervising for numbers
* Comfortable owning a number (trust/NPS, SLA adherence, retention) and reporting on it upward with a plan, not just a status
* Willing to travel across campuses within the zone



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience running distributed or multi\-location teams

description:
**Role Summary** 




 The Parent Relationship Head owns the parent relationship function end to end — the playbook every campus runs on, the two zonal Senior Managers, and the escalation of last resort for anything neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager can close. Because this function sits directly on parent trust, it calls for someone still early enough in their leadership career to be hands\-on and hungry to build — not someone managing an already\-mature machine. You are setting the standard once, so a parent gets the same quality of engagement whichever zone or campus their ward is on, and owning the function's standing — one trust/NPS number, company\-wide — for leadership to see.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Function ownership**

* **People leadership** 
 — hire, review, and hold accountable the two zonal Senior Managers, and keep people practices consistent across both zones
* **Escalation of last resort** 
 — pick up what neither a Manager nor a Senior Manager could close — especially anything that touches a parent's trust in NIAT or NIAT's reputation
* **Executive reporting** 
 — consolidate both zones into a single parent trust/NPS and function\-health view for leadership, rather than leaving it as two separate zonal stories
* **Education strategy** 
 — own the company\-wide parent education and communication calendar — newsletters, program updates, new\-economy career awareness
* **Cross\-functional alignment** 
 — represent the function with Program Ops, University Partnerships, the Student Relationship function, and Infrastructure \& Facilities Excellence


- 


**What Success Looks Like — Key Result Areas** 




**KRA Metric** 




**Company\-wide parent trust / NPS\-** 
 NPS rolled up across both zones
 



**Escalation\-of\-last\-resort TAT\-** 
 Time to close issues escalated past a Senior Manager
 



**Ratio policy adherence\-** 
 Company\-wide adherence to the 1:300 mapping ratio
 



**Senior Manager performance\-** 
 Both zones meeting their Senior Manager KRAs
 



**Education program reach\-** 
 % of parents reached by the quarterly education calendar
 



**Playbook adoption\-** 
 Standards (SLAs, tracker, ratio policy) applied consistently across both zones
 



*Note: Targets and review cadence for each KRA are being finalised by the function.* 




  





**Who We're Looking For** 



* 10–14 years overall experience, including several years managing managers or running a multi\-location, relationship\- or trust\-facing function

* Comfortable being the final escalation point on sensitive, emotionally\-charged, or reputation\-sensitive issues

 This is currently the function's senior\-most role; a strong incumbent grows the scope of the function itself — more zones, a larger bench, a deeper education program — as NIAT scales.

title: Operations Fulfilment Manager
description:
**About the Company** 




  





 AdOnMo is one of India's largest and fastest\-growing Out\-of\-Home (OOH) advertising companies, backed by marquee investors like Zomato, Ant Financial, and Astarc Ventures.
 



 We operate a vast and expanding network of 33,000\+ digital screens (outside lifts) and 20,000\+ static frame posters (inside lifts) across 24\+ major cities, including Hyderabad, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Pune, Chennai, Kochi, Jaipur, and more.
 



 Our ad formats are installed in high\-visibility public locations, including:
 


* Residential societies
* Corporate buildings and coworking spaces
* Cult.fit gyms
* Goa beaches
* Shopping malls
* Bike parking areas with branded standees and digital hoardings



 We work with 2,000\+ brands, including Amazon, IKEA, Meta, and Zomato, helping them build real\-world visibility through innovative and targeted outdoor advertising campaigns.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an Operations Fulfilment Manager to join the Acumen team and take ownership of the fulfilment journey end\-to\-end.
 



 The role will involve coordinating closely with production, warehouse, installation, Operations and Customer Success teams to ensure orders move as planned, timelines are met, and client escalations are resolved effectively.
 



 The ideal candidate should be organised, dependable, hands\-on, and comfortable working across multiple teams, with strong ownership of execution and follow\-through.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Experience: 3\+ years



  





  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* *1\. Own Fulfilment End\-to\-End*
* Track every order from production and dispatch through delivery, installation and go\-live.
* Maintain complete visibility on the status of every open order.
* Ensure orders progress through each stage as planned and are successfully closed.



  




* *2\. Drive Coordination and Timelines*
* Work closely with Production, Warehouse, Installation, Operations and Customer Success teams.
* Identify potential delays and bottlenecks early.
* Coordinate with relevant teams to ensure orders move as planned and timelines are met.



  




* *3\. Own Client Escalations*
* Take complete ownership of client escalations related to fulfilment.
* Communicate clearly and calmly with stakeholders.
* Drive issues through to closure and ensure that escalations do not remain unresolved.



  




* *4\. Keep the Team and Process on Track*
* Support the existing Operations team in managing day\-to\-day fulfilment activities.
* Maintain a simple, accurate and up\-to\-date order tracker.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure clear accountability for every next step.
* Maintain visibility on pending orders and ensure timely follow\-ups.



  




* *5\. Identify and Improve Recurring Issues*
* Identify patterns and recurring challenges in the fulfilment process.
* Proactively highlight issues to leadership.
* Suggest practical process improvements to reduce recurring fulfilment challenges and improve operational efficiency.



  





  





  





**Required Skills** 



* 3\+ years of experience in Operations, Fulfilment, Client Delivery, Service Delivery or a similar role.
* Experience managing end\-to\-end fulfilment or delivery processes.
* Strong coordination skills with the ability to work across multiple teams.
* Experience handling client/stakeholder escalations and driving them to closure.
* Strong follow\-up and execution skills.
* Comfortable maintaining trackers, monitoring pending actions and managing multiple orders simultaneously.
* Ability to identify operational challenges and suggest practical solutions.
* Highly organised, dependable and hands\-on approach to work.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment with multiple priorities.



  





  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in a similar Operations, Fulfilment, Service Delivery, Client Delivery, Logistics, Installation or Project Execution role would be preferred.



  





  





**Equal Opportunity Statement** 




 AdOnMo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

**Position Purpose**
 The Client Success Manager (CSM) is accountable for the overall health, retention, satisfaction, and growth of an assigned portfolio of clients. Acting as a trusted advisor and executive relationship owner, the CSM develops a deep understanding of each client's business strategy, industry environment, operational processes, and technology landscape to ensure clients realize maximum value from ADP solutions.

The CSM serves as the voice of the client within ADP while representing ADP's capabilities, strategy, and product roadmap to clients.

The CSM is expected to leverage insights into the client's organization, workforce strategy, and technology environment to uncover opportunities for expansion, optimization, and innovation. title: Lead – Supply Chain Operations & Customer Experience
description:
This is precise because it names both functions the role actually owns (not a generic "founder's office" or "chief of staff" label that pulls in unrelated generalists), and it's the exact phrase candidates with real supply chain/ops \+ CX experience search for and apply against.
 



  





 If you can spot where a business is leaking, understand why, and build the fix, this role is for you. Direct founder access, full business context from day one, and real accountability for outcomes across two critical functions CX and Operations.
 



  





**1\. Customer Experience \& Retention** 



* Own the post\-purchase journey end to end — from first delivery to repeat purchase, including re\-order nudges, win\-back campaigns, loyalty mechanics
* Track cohort repeat rates, time\-to\-second\-order, churn triggers, and NPS by product/channel via a weekly retention dashboard
* Own CX metrics as performance targets CSAT, first response time, resolution SLA, repeat complaint rate, NPS, repeat purchase rate, refund/return rate
* Write, own, audit, and update the CX SOP library complaint handling, delivery delay resolution, escalation matrices, agent playbooks
* Run RCA on every recurring failure trace root cause, fix the source, update the SOP, verify the fix held
* Feed CX insights upstream to inform NPD, formulation, and supply chain decisions
* Own the CX tech stack ticketing, WhatsApp automation, logistics webhooks



  





**2\. Supply Chain \& Operations** 



* Own the Operations SOP library procurement, inbound QC, CMO coordination, warehouse, dispatch, returns
* Drive SOP adherence through floor\-level checks and exception tracking
* Run RCA on operational failures (batch rejection, delivery delay, procurement gap) and verify fixes over 2\-3 cycles
* Own the CMO performance scorecard on\-time delivery, batch quality, rejection rates, CoA compliance
* Own inventory planning reduce OOS without creating excess stock or working capital lock\-in
* Own 3PL coordination — NDR management, RTO reduction, SLA adherence, exception\-handling SOPs



**3\. Business Intelligence \& Cross\-Functional Work** 



* Build founder dashboards as early\-warning systems, not rear\-view mirrors
* Track retention\-led revenue metrics — cohort repeat rates, refund/return trends, complaint\-to\-churn correlation, fulfilment SLA impact on NPS
* Own cross\-functional projects from intake through prioritisation, execution, and closure



**Must\-have:** 



* 1\-8 years post\-qualification experience in consulting, operations, supply chain, a founder's office, or a high\-ownership role at a D2C/FMCG/consumer startup (Tier 1 consulting or early startup particularly valued)
* Independently builds data models and turns complex operational problems into crisp recommendations
* Has built SOPs from scratch, run RCA when they broke, and closed the loop at root cause
* Comfortable moving between strategic framing and ground\-level execution
* High ownership orientation accountable for outcomes, not just outputs



**Strongly preferred:** 



* CX operations with a retention/revenue lens cohort tracking, post\-purchase engagement flows, loyalty programme impact
* Hands\-on procurement or vendor management with CMOs or RM/PM suppliers
* Shopify, Freshdesk/Zoho Desk, Shiprocket, Klaviyo, advanced Excel/Sheets; SQL or data viz a bonus

title: Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**Description**
 The Global Accounts Receivable (GAR) Customer Experience team exists for one reason: make sure every customer interaction with Amazon's AR function is so good it strengthens the relationship and accelerates revenue collection. We do this across 8 business channels and 9 support centers worldwide, building smarter processes, better communication, and technology that scales.
   

  

 We're looking for a Senior CX Manager who can turn that mission into results. You'll lead the AR customer experience function across some of Amazon's largest and fastest\-growing business channels: AWS, Amazon Business, Retail, Advertising, and Transportation, ensuring every AR touchpoint with customers and vendors meets a high bar. You'll do this through a globally distributed team of Customer Experience Specialists, and you co\-own the global CX metric with Operations, which means you're accountable for what customers actually experience, not just what's planned on a slide.
   

  

 This is a people\-leadership role at its core. You'll manage across time zones and cultures, coach CX Specialists into independent problem\-solvers, and build mechanisms that work when you're not in the room. But you also need to be hands\-on with data, comfortable pulling apart CX trends, building root\-cause models, and presenting findings to senior leaders who expect clarity and a point of view.
   

  

 You'll need to design scalable automation (partnering with FinTech and FinAuto), deploy ML\-powered sentiment detection, and build self\-service tools that reduce manual effort. If you're energized by operating in a high\-growth, high\-ambiguity environment where you have to invent the playbook, this is the role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Key Responsibilities Will Include, But Are Not Limited To**
 CX Strategy \& Metric Ownership
   

  

* Own end\-to\-end CX quality across assigned businesses, driving measurable year\-over\-year improvement in defect rates and customer response quality
* Define the annual CX roadmap: balance quick wins that move the needle this quarter with structural fixes that compound over time


 Automation \& Technology
   

  

* Partner with FinTech, FinAuto, and Data Engineering teams to design and deploy solutions that reduce manual touchpoints: zero\-touch email responses, intelligent case routing, automated root\-cause tagging
* Drive adoption and improvement of ML\-powered negative sentiment analysis to proactively flag and resolve customer concerns before they become escalations
* Own the rollout of next\-generation communication and feedback management tools that improve first\-contact resolution rates and shrink resolution time


 Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Be the CX voice in cross\-functional forums. Influence upstream teams to fix root causes, not just symptoms, of customer friction
* Partner with Tech and Operations leadership to align on priorities, share data, and unblock execution
* Plan and deliver global CX Summits and Vendor Experience forums that drive mechanism adoption and build a culture of customer obsession across support centers


 People Leadership
   

  

* Manage, develop, and inspire Customer Experience Specialists across the globe — each with distinct operating rhythms and cultural contexts
* Set clear goals, provide regular coaching, and create development paths that grow your team's analytical depth, stakeholder presence, and ownership
* Build a team culture where data\-backed experimentation, dive deep, bias for action, and customer obsession are the default


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in business economics, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, information technology or equivalent, or a Bachelor's degree and experience or equivalent experience in finance roles
* 
* 10\+ years of professional experience in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Program Management, or a related analytical role
* 
* 5\+ years of people management experience, including managing geographically distributed teams
* 
* Track record of driving measurable improvements in customer experience or service quality metrics at scale

* Strong data fluency — ability to build business cases, interrogate complex datasets, and translate findings into action\-oriented narratives for senior leadership

* Experience managing cross\-functional projects with competing priorities, providing escalation management, and making trade\-offs
* 
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to work in ambiguous, fast\-paced environments


**Preferred Qualifications**
